criteria.description: Identify the electroplating/chemical-plating product-capacity mapping conflict, preserve conflicting values, and request primary records rather than moving actual output.
Recalculate polymer load from 400 kg/a over 300 days without prematurely rounding the daily denominator: 90.0% and 82.5%.
Reconcile the 22000/68800 investment bases and scope without treating the amount change alone as proof of a major physical change.
Match operating and treatment records to the relevant 21-24 September monitoring dates; a missing record is an evidence gap, not proof of unstable operation.
Preserve reported inputs and identify that 23192 x 3.59 x 10^-6 equals 0.08325928 kg/h, not 0.833 kg/h; request traceable correction.
Evaluate all day and night results against 65/55 dB(A), recognizing maxima 59/49 and six-dB margins.
Treat slash/no listed total-phosphorus limit as unavailable compliance criterion, neither pass nor zero/infinity.
Treat COD ND under the 4 mg/L detection limit as censored in [0,4), not measured zero, and avoid unsupported derived use.
Recognize that the cited 10 mg/m3 NMHC clause is limited to large units while this project is stated medium; do not infer exceedance from unsupported draft 1.0.
Resolve source- and height-specific limit conflicts, including 24/25 m and odor 500 versus draft 6000, before scoped conclusions.
Do not infer compliance with the 69.8 kg/a VOC cap from a short campaign; request source/activity/control accounting for an annual result.
For oil-fume outlet concentration, take the larger measured/reference value (0.3 and 0.4), compare it with 1.0, and keep inlet outside the outlet compliance test.
Keep 90% removal efficiency unresolved until same-event paired oil-fume concentration and flow evidence is available; do not use concentration ratios or splice NMHC flows.
Identify conflicting ordinary/hazardous classification and destination for contaminated chemical packaging and request supported classification and route without inventing a code.
Request specific existing records tied to open decisions; request targeted additional work only when records cannot establish validity, not an automatic full retest.
Limit the opinion to the supplied September 2022 first-phase dossier, withhold unconditional acceptance pending closure, and avoid fabricated illegality, approval, inspection, or scope extension.

Review the laboratory stacks DA001 through DA012 as their own source group. Identify the incomplete stack table and the applicable 50% derating issue, including the 4.2 kg/h and 7 kg/h values where supported, and request source-specific completion or recalculation. Do not substitute the wastewater-station 14 kg/h value or award credit for unbound numbers and action words. Accept equivalent evidence-bounded Chinese expression.

evidence_extraction: Read tests/read_word_comments.py extract_docx. Include native comments with their real anchors. Preserved draft assertions are evidence under review, not reviewer endorsement. Each business fact has one exclusive criterion owner.
